| `selectable`               | `selectable`             | Determines if the table displays checkboxes for selectable rows.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | `boolean`           | `undefined` |
| `tableLayout`              | `table-layout`           | Sets how the table sizes its columns. With `auto`, each column is sized from its content, so columns can change width when the rows change (for example after a sort). With `fixed`, columns take the `width` set on their `pds-table-head-cell` and ignore their content; columns without a `width` share the remaining space. Under `responsive`, that remaining share keeps a 120px floor on narrow viewports where the other columns' widths already fill it, growing the table instead (scrollable) -- without `responsive` there's no floor, since there would be nothing to scroll the overflow it would create. Content longer than its column overflows, so add `truncate` to cells whose content may not fit. | `"auto" \| "fixed"` | `'auto'`    |


## Events

| Event               | Description                                                                                                                                                                     | Type                                    |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `pdsTableSelectAll` | Event that is emitted by `pds-table-head` when the select all checkbox is clicked, carrying the selected value. It bubbles through the table; the table doesn't emit it itself. | `CustomEvent<{ isSelected: boolean; }>` |


## Shadow Parts

| Part                     | Description                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `"responsive-container"` | Exposes the horizontal scroll container for styling. Appears only when `responsive` is set.                                                                                            |
| `"responsive-table"`     | Set on the `pds-table` element itself when `responsive` is set, so `::part(responsive-table)` matches it only from a shadow root that contains it. Style `pds-table` directly instead. |
| `"responsive-wrapper"`   | Exposes the wrapper inside the scroll container for styling. Appears only when `responsive` is set.                                                                                    |
| `"scroll-shadow-left"`   | Exposes the scroll shadow at the inline-start edge for styling. Appears only when `responsive` is set.                                                                                 |
| `"scroll-shadow-right"`  | Exposes the scroll shadow at the inline-end edge for styling. Appears only when `responsive` is set.                                                                                   |
| `"table"`                | Set on the `pds-table` element itself, so `::part(table)` matches it only from a shadow root that contains it. Style `pds-table` directly instead.                                     |
| `"table-inner"`          | Exposes the inner table element around the slotted head and body for styling. Appears only when `responsive` is set.                                                                   |
